# railway_workspace_members (Data Source)

Members of a Railway workspace. Pending invitations are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_workspace_members" "example" {
  workspace_id = railway_project.example.workspace_id
}

# Look up users by email, e.g. in a module that takes a list of emails.
resource "railway_access_group" "from_emails" {
  workspace_id = data.railway_workspace_members.example.workspace_id
  name         = "platform"
  role         = "MEMBER"
  member_ids   = [for email in var.member_emails : data.railway_workspace_members.example.ids_by_email[email]]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source, same as `workspace_id`.
- `ids_by_email` (Map of String) Map of member email to user identifier, for looking up a member by email. Emails are as stored by Railway.
- `members` (Attributes List) Members of the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email of the user.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the user.
- `name` (String) Name of the user.
- `role` (String) Role of the user in the workspace.
